name: Check Condidate data
query:
SELECT 
    name,
    email,
    contact_number,
    exprience,
    skills,
    role,
    last_qualification,
    address,
    resume
FROM `tabCondidate`
WHERE name = %(name)s
AND role = %(role)s;
